title: Abuse of Legal Process - teaching pattern

content.body: Educational hypothetical, not an official statutory illustration and not a new decided case. Use only the law already recorded in this topic file. Facts already recorded in this topic file: Case requires authoritative judgment verification before publication. Issue already recorded: What is the scope of the relevant tort doctrine? Recorded ingredient used: The gravamen of abuse of process is misuse or perversion of process for an improper collateral purpose. Courts distinguish an improper use of an otherwise valid process from the mere fact that a party lost or brought an unsuccessful proceeding. Application: a person affected by Abuse of Legal Process places only those recorded facts before the forum already named in this file. Match each recorded ingredient. Where every recorded ingredient is present, the recorded rule applies and the result stops at that rule. Authority already recorded in this file, not a new citation: West Bengal State Electricity Board v. Dilip Kumar Ray 2006. Use it only as already written here.
